content.short: Coala Pay helps humanitarian organisations deliver aid payments in minutes using stablecoins.
content.description: Coala Pay is a payments platform for humanitarian and aid organisations, using stablecoins to get money to people in minutes rather than weeks, with compliance tools for tracking disbursements. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Coala Pay.
content.meta: Coala Pay delivers humanitarian aid payments in minutes using stablecoins, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
